about_the_game:
LingTian 2 is a romantic and sweet otome visual novel game. As an ordinary girl from Fang Kingdom, your fate with Prince LingTian begins because of your kind heart. Now, your love and romance are about to unfold, ready to welcome this magnificent royal romance!

▌Romance

The Fang Kingdom royal family holds the "Quest For Love Event" for Prince LingTian to find his princess, using it as a way to divert public attention and ease social tensions. After the royal exam, you and other girls advance to the finals. However, as soon as you step into the Fang Palace, the prince pays special attention to you, protecting you in every way. Inside the palace, the girls must find the hidden "Fang Cards" to earn a chance to date the prince. However, Prince LingTian secretly helps you cheat, providing you with clues to monopolize your time with him.

Even when you mistakenly bite the prince, he still unconditionally defends you, never blaming you. When soldiers subdue you, the prince, despite his injuries, harshly rebukes the soldiers, refusing to let them harm you.

On the snowy day, the prince personally welcomes the girls into the palace and gives them phones as a greeting gift. Soon, the other girls realize that their phones can't contact the prince, but only you can make calls and send messages. When you ask him about it, the prince answers with deep affection: "Because I only like you. I have no interest in the other girls. I only care about you, only focus on you, and only want to be with you."

▌Full Game Version

Over 1,000 exquisite 3D scenes

Full character voice acting and sound effects

Interact with the prince’s heartbeat, warmth, and breathing, unlocking his room and clues

10 interactive sections where the prince will call, message, accompany, and lull you to sleep

10 side storylines, different choices leading to different endings

3 mini-games to enhance fun and exploration

10 beautiful theme songs to immerse you in love

Adapted from Ginyan's novel, a sweet romantic story of over 100,000 words

▌About Fang Kingdom

Fang Kingdom is a new nation formed on a square landmass created by tectonic movement after World War III. It is a free, equal, and inclusive country where multiple ethnicities and languages coexist. The people of Fang Kingdom are naturally romantic and passionate about love.

▌The Prince and You

LingTian — Prince of Fang Kingdom, the fourth heir to the throne, handsome and upright, diligent and loyal. Before the "Love Search Event," he had already deeply fallen in love with you. To help you enter the Fang Palace, he spared no effort, and no matter what happens to you, he unconditionally protects you. Even after you mistakenly bite the prince, thinking you'll be eliminated, the prince only worries about you being punished, not caring about his own injury, only wanting to protect you.

You — Kind and hardworking, skilled in cooking, your specialty being braised pork rice. While studying at a culinary academy and working part-time at a restaurant, you made it to the finals and entered the Fang Palace. Faced with the prince, you feel both nervous and shy… While all the other girls try to win his favor, you mistakenly bite him, thinking you’ll be eliminated. Soon after, you unexpectedly reunite with Chengxun, who has become a royal guard. Chengxun tells you that the prince truly likes you…

▌Gameplay

Watch the story/make choices: Immerse in a movie-like story, progress your romance with the prince, and unlock rooms and clues.

Mini-games: Fun gameplay like applying ointment to the prince, solving puzzles with clues.

Daily interaction and companionship: Communicate with the prince through calls, messages, and diaries.

Songs and video reviews: Relive romantic moments and feel the heartbeat.

▌Reincarnation Series

"Fang Kingdom Prince Past and Present Dream Reincarnation Series" — Four princes, LingTian, ZhenTing, BiWei, and LiNuo, together weave an eternal love across time. The people of Fang Kingdom believe in reincarnation, and through past-life retrospection, LingTian and you realize that your love has not only existed in this life but has been accumulated over many lifetimes.

1-Ling Tian: Your Fated Prince in This Life | Prince LingTian has fallen deeply in love with you at first sight in this life. His pursuit of love is merely to bring you into the Fang Palace. He wants to wholeheartedly repay and cherish you.

2-Zhen Ting: Your Devoted Prince in the Past Life | Prince ZhenTing of Fang Kingdom attended military school, always watching over and protecting you, who worked in the kitchen there. His intense and passionate romance with you is full of devotion.

3-BiWei: Your Prince Classmate in the Past Life | you blocked a bullet for the prince, which allowed you to attend the Royal High School. Prince BiWei deeply guarded you and returned your sweet campus romance.

4-LiNuo: Your Insomniac Prince in the Past Life | Prince LiNuo needed you to feed his stomach and be by his side for him to sleep. Your sweet love healed his insomnia.

This love across reincarnations, no matter how many lifetimes, will never cease…

⚠️ Important Notice

  • The game uses a large amount of AI, including AI-generated images, AI voiceovers, and AI music.

  • All story content is adapted from novels written by the developer Ginyan.

  • This is an otome visual novel game with simple player controls.

▌About the Developer

Ginyan, I am an independent otome game developer as well as an e-book author and online tutor. I teach and create foreign language learning ebooks. I am passionate about computers and languages. Using the romance novels I write as the basis for my game scripts, I taught myself the Unity game engine and Naninovel, developing the game on my own with the help of various AI tools.
